name: Kirby and the Knight's Curse
source:
Unravel the mystery that surrounds Kirby (mute prince of Pop Star) and his personal guard, Metaknight, as the two chase after a sinister foe who has placed a curse onto the dark knight. Though, as with all things, everything is not as it seems…

Kirby fangame.

[Edited from [url=http://renai.us/game/kirby-and-the-knights-curse]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
揭開困擾波普之星啞巴王子卡比與貼身護衛魅塔騎士的謎團：兩人追逐一個給黑暗騎士施加詛咒的邪惡敵人。然而，事情從來不是表面那樣……

卡比同人遊戲。

［改編自[url=http://renai.us/game/kirby-and-the-knights-curse]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]］
